summary: Build a simple app to generate complete product files (PDFs and downloadable assets) for three digital AI-automation products, suitable for uploading to Gumroad or Etsy.
architectural_notes: Simple app that outputs PDFs and packaged downloadable assets intended for Gumroad/Etsy distribution.

existing_features.title: Create a frontend workflow to define and manage three digital product entries (title, subtitle, description, included modules/chapters, prompts/templates/checklists, and optional branding fields), with an editor UI that supports saving drafts locally and regenerating outputs on demand.

Generate complete product files for each of the three products as downloadable assets, including at minimum: (1) a multi-page PDF document and (2) a structured bundle of supplementary files (e.g., TXT/MD templates, checklists, prompt packs) packaged into a single ZIP per product.

Provide a “Gumroad/Etsy export” screen that summarizes the generated deliverables for each product (what’s included, file sizes, and a preview thumbnail), and offers one-click download per product plus a “Download all products” option that creates a single ZIP containing all three product ZIPs.

Add a lightweight backend canister API to store/retrieve product definitions and generation metadata (e.g., last generated time, version tag) so the app can persist product content beyond the browser and support multi-device use with Internet Identity login.

Apply a coherent, distinctive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) appropriate for a “digital product generator” tool, and keep all user-facing text in English.
Add in-app previews: a quick PDF preview (first pages or a rendered preview panel) and a ZIP content preview (tree/list of files that will be included) before downloading.
Include static generated brand/cover imagery for the three products (one cover image per product) as part of the downloadable bundle, and render these images in the UI as preview thumbnails.

Add an in-app, step-by-step instructions section (English) that explains how to use the app end-to-end (edit products, generate bundles, preview, and download), and how to upload the generated files to Gumroad and to Etsy.

Include the same step-by-step usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the generated downloadable documentation by expanding the README content produced for each product ZIP and the master all-products ZIP.
Add a first-launch onboarding modal that automatically opens the first time a user opens the app in a given browser and presents the app usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the app.

Ensure the onboarding modal does not block required first-time profile setup: if the profile setup dialog is shown (authenticated user with no profile), show profile setup first; only show the onboarding modal after profile setup is complete or if profile setup is not needed.
Provide a persistent way for users to re-open the onboarding instructions modal after dismissing it (for example, a header link/button labeled "Instructions" or "Help").

Build a simple app that generates the PDFs and downloadable assets for the three products
